name: Front-leg stretch Bow
completion: Hold the front-leg stretch bow, reverse the reach and body shift, then return to exact standing and hold.
adaptation: Emulate V1 Bow with extended front forelegs, lowered front body and raised rear. Front soles reach forward 20 mm as the body moves back 10 mm; front carriers and cranks produce the stretch. V1 electrical angles are not copied.
contact_model: Measured convex sole rolling with an intentional synchronized 20 mm forward slide of both front ground contacts during stretch, reversed on return. Rear contacts retain fixed material vertices between rolling transfers. Sliding friction and physical load distribution are unverified.
